Name: Hophra
Summary: Hophra was Pharaoh of Egypt in the days after Jerusalem's fall; Jeremiah declared that God would give Hophra into the hand of his enemies, just as Zedekiah had been given into Nebuchadnezzar's hand.
KeyStory: Jeremiah gave the Jews who fled to Egypt a sign: Pharaoh-hophra would be delivered to those seeking his life, as surely as Zedekiah had been delivered to Babylon.
LifeLesson: Fleeing to Egypt for safety only moved the judgment to Egypt.
